requirements.purpose: make continuity tangible through a real founder environment
visualize viability and the evidence-gated path without software-chart clichés

concepts.name: The Studio Continues
concepts.message: The venture remains prepared and legible while the founder steps away.
concepts.visual_approach: quiet documentary workspace at dawn with evidence-bearing objects and an asleep screen

concepts.name: The Viable Field
concepts.message: A path can keep moving because it respects a living boundary.
concepts.visual_approach: tactile archival field plate blending growth rings with phase-space trajectories

shot_list.generation_prompt: Quiet editorial documentary photograph of a founder's studio at dawn after the founder has stepped away: open paper ledger, worn desk, circular brass instrument, copper pencil mark, sleeping laptop, soft garden beyond the window; right-third subject placement, left negative space; warm-muted natural light; no people, data, text, robots, neon, or AI clichés.
shot_list.label: Illustrative — generated brand expression, not product proof

shot_list.generation_prompt: Macro mixed-media topographic field on embossed handmade paper, combining growth rings with a phase-space trajectory that approaches a boundary, bends inward, and continues; one copper decision mark; left-center subject, right negative space; lichen, bone, new growth, copper; no text, arrows, infinity, UI, neon, or watermark.
shot_list.label: Illustrative — generated brand expression, not product proof
